topic.title: MCP Server Service (mcp-server)
topic.shortdesc: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing OASIS metadata, clean Markdown text context, search, and MCP-UI interactive component rendering to AI assistants.

section.title: Service Overview
section.p: The mcp-server service operates on port 4001 (HTTP transport) or via standard I/O (stdio transport). It connects AI models to published DITA documentation sets.

plentry.pd: Discovers available documentation sets and returns OASIS metadata (title, description, keywords, category, lang).
Returns the hierarchical Table of Contents structure for a document set.
Executes documentation search queries. Transparently delegates to rag-service if configured, with automatic fallback to MiniSearch keyword search.
Converts topic AST JSON trees into clean Markdown text for LLM reasoning and question-answering.
MCP-UI Tool returning a self-contained HTML/CSS frame rendering interactive React components directly inside chat windows.

section.title: Search Delegation & Fallback Architecture
section.p: When the search_documentation tool is called, mcp-server evaluates its configured search providers:

ul.li: Semantic RAG Search: If RAG_SERVICE_URL is set (e.g. http://rag-service:4002), queries are sent to the standalone vector search service.
Keyword Search Fallback: If rag-service is unconfigured, unreachable, or returns empty results, queries automatically fall back to local MiniSearch indices without disrupting chat flow.

section.title: Container Deployment & Configuration
section.p: Deploy using Docker Compose or a standalone Docker container:
section.codeblock:
# Launch using Docker Compose: docker compose up -d mcp-server
# Or run as a standalone Docker container: docker run -d -p 4001:4001 \ -v /path/to/data:/app/data \ -e RAG_SERVICE_URL=http://rag-service:4002 \ ghcr.io/jason-fox/ast-mcp-server:latest

plentry.pd: HTTP port for Streamable HTTP transport (default: 4001).
Optional URL of the standalone RAG vector search service (e.g. http://localhost:4002).
Bootswatch theme name used for render_topic_ui frames (default: default).
